# Tracker notes

Work on this repository is tracked in GitHub issues. This folder holds what is left of the old
Backlog.md board.

- `id-map.json` maps each legacy board id (`GRE-0001`) to the issue it became. `just issue <ID>`
  prints that issue; maintainers need the tracker tools for it.
- `history/` holds the retired board documents. They are redacted for a public repository and kept
  as written, so do not edit them.
